header.running_head: Learning and Teaching the Qur'aan and Reciting it to People

blocks.text: Thaabit (RA)) would never voice his opinion concerning anything he was asked about until he ascertained whether the matter problem had already occurred. If it did not yet occur he would not say anything and he would comment only if it had occurred. Therefore, whenever he was once asked something, he queried, "Has it already happened?" "O Abu Sa'eed," the reply would come, "it has not yet happened, but we are preparing for it." "Then leave it," he would reply. It was then only when the incident actually occurred that he would duly inform the people (about what to do). [^1]

Hadhrat Masrooq relates, "When I once questioned Hadhrat Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) about something, he asked, 'Has this actually occurred?' When I informed him that it did not, he remarked, 'Then let us rest until it does.'" Another narration[^2] adds that he said, "Then let us rest until it does happen. Then when it does happen, we shall be able to apply ourselves and to get a solution for you." [^3]

Hadhrat Aamir narrates that when Hadhrat Ammaar (RA) was once questioned about something, he asked, "Has this actually occurred?" When informed that it did not, he remarked, "Then leave us until it does. Then when it happens, we shall be able to apply ourselves and to get a solution for you." [^4]
Learning and Teaching the Qur'aan and Reciting it to People
Rasulullaah ﷺ Encourages a Person who Earned a Profit to Learn the Qur'aan

Hadhrat Abu Umaamah (RA) narrates that a man once came to Rasulullaah ﷺ and explained how much profit he had earned by buying (and selling) the shares of a particular tribe. "Should I not inform you about something even more profitable?" Rasulullaah ﷺ asked. "Can there be anything more profitable?" the man asked. Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "For a man to learn ten verses of the Qur'aan." The man then went to learn ten verses, which he reported to Rasulullaah ﷺ. [^5]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Teaches Hadhrat Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) the Virtue of Surah Faatiha

Hadhrat Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) narrates, "Rasulullaah ﷺ once said to me, 'Should I not inform you of a Surah, the like of which has not been revealed in the Torah, the Zaboor, the Injeel or the Qur'aan?'
